% AutoNIMA manuscript -- bioRxiv preprint layout, Methods at the end.
%
% Build:  ./build.sh        (latexmk -pdf, runs BibTeX as needed)
%
% body.tex and supplementary.tex are GENERATED by convert.py from the Google
% Docs export. Once the Doc is no longer the source of truth, stop running
% convert.py and edit those two files directly.
%
% This preamble deliberately uses only what ships with texlive-latex-base, so it
% builds on a minimal TeX install. See the OPTIONAL block below for the nicer
% packages and the one apt command that provides them.
\documentclass[11pt]{article}

\usepackage[letterpaper,margin=1in]{geometry}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}

% Bitstream Charter for text, Times for math, Helvetica for headings. Charter
% was drawn for low-resolution output, so it holds up on screen where Computer
% Modern's thin strokes go weak. mathptmx is loaded first so that charter wins
% for the body and only the math is Times.
\usepackage{mathptmx}
\usepackage{charter}
\usepackage[scaled=0.92]{helvet}
\usepackage{microtype}

% Numeric superscript citations with compressed ranges, so 7,8,9,10,11 sets as
% 7-11 exactly as the Doc had them.
\usepackage[super,comma,sort&compress]{natbib}
\bibliographystyle{unsrtnat}

% hyperref needs etoolbox, which texlive-latex-base does not ship. Load it when
% it is available and fall back to plain text when it is not, so the document
% builds on a minimal install.
\IfFileExists{etoolbox.sty}{%
  \usepackage[colorlinks=true,allcolors=blue,breaklinks=true]{hyperref}%
}{%
  \providecommand{\href}[2]{##2}%
  \providecommand{\url}[1]{\texttt{##1}}%
  \typeout{NOTE: hyperref unavailable (no etoolbox); links are plain text.}%
}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- OPTIONAL ---
% Uncomment for circulating a draft; both are review aids, not preprint style.
%   \usepackage{setspace}\onehalfspacing
%   \usepackage{lineno}\linenumbers
% -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
\linespread{1.16}

% Nature-style captions: "Fig. 1 | Title. Body...", with no "Figure 1:" prefix.
\renewcommand{\figurename}{Fig.}
\makeatletter
\long\def\@makecaption#1#2{%
  \vskip\abovecaptionskip
  \begingroup\small
    \textbf{#1\,\textbar}\ #2\par
  \endgroup
  \vskip\belowcaptionskip}
\makeatother

% Sans-serif headings against the serif body.
\usepackage{sectsty}
\allsectionsfont{\sffamily\bfseries}

\setcounter{secnumdepth}{0}   % Nature-style: unnumbered headings
\setlength{\parskip}{0.4em}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}

\title{\vspace{-2em}\bfseries Automated neuroimaging meta-analysis through
LLM-guided selection improves recovery of published spatial patterns}
